Rhino 3DM written by rhino3dm itself (File3dm.toByteArray): a NURBS sphere of radius 5
at the origin, stored as a Brep, and a five-vertex mesh pyramid beside it. The Brep was
built in code and carries no render mesh, so Rhino3dmLoader skips it with a "missing
mesh" warning; the mesh decodes. A decode therefore exercises both the warning path and
the geometry path of the loader's worker.
